items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: And many bands on the road. Duke, Fletcher Henderson.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'll be 62 years old, I think, this Christmas. Not I think, I better be sure. Not 62, 57. 57. 57. I take that back, because I ain't ashamed to tell my age. And many bands on the road. Duke, Fletcher Henderson. I have played bass with him when the first thing they put the hatchet on the band. Red Allen time, he was playing with him in that time. Which him and I raised up together. Down on Verrett Street. Yeah, right across from the graveyard. He may yell this and he know this old twat talking. Well, in them…
